cells.gaps: No source found says a national open data portal is running under the strategy; the government told the World Bank in 2025 that it had none (MRT-002).
cells.note: The minister told the National Assembly on 29 May 2025 that the open data and interoperability strategy of June 2023 had been adopted (MRT-003), so a policy is adopted and running: stage 3. Stage 4 needs a government portal running under it, and none is found.
